title: world3 style pack
description: A named bundle of capture-time / render-time visual overrides. Applied by the orchestrator on top of bundle defaults; the bundle itself is style-pack-independent so the same bundle can be re-rendered in different styles without rebuild.

id.description: Style pack identifier, matches the filename (without .json) and the request.style_pack field.

render.description: Render-time knobs passed to OrchestratorCaptureDriver.gd. Any field omitted falls back to World3AutoReviewTour defaults.

material_suffix.description: Optional per-style material variant suffix (e.g. 'photoreal' -> terrain_blend_<kit>_<mode>.tres; 'topographic' -> terrain_blend_<kit>_<mode>_topographic.tres). Empty/omitted means use the standard per-mode .tres.
